decisions.reason: The operator training programme had its own page in two consecutive years and supports the firm's machine business, so it is visibly committed and cheap to sustain.
The fourth rotary axis accessory was only mentioned on the website, which signals low commitment, but it complements the core machines and costs little to keep offering.

Hybrid additive post-processing was only mentioned and is the least core product, but it fits the firm's announced technology direction and weak results can still be blamed on the temporary 2020-2021 market slump.
The high-speed CNC milling machine is a heavy, publicly showcased investment central to the firm's identity, so sunk costs and the need to justify it strongly favour persisting.
The automatic tool change system had its own page and is integral to the CNC machine line, so substantial investment and visible commitment argue for keeping it.
